jobs.description: We are looking for an Electrical Commissioning Specialist at Academic Work Finland Oy in Helsinki, Vantaa, Kerava, and surrounding areas. This role involves commissioning electrical systems within L0-L6 levels, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, and ensuring the safe and controlled commissioning of data centers. Supporting the planning and execution of the L5 Integrated System Test (IST) phase and verifying inter-system functionality.
what_we_offer: A key role in the safe and controlled commissioning of a technically demanding data center.
An opportunity to work with critical electrical systems and integrated testing in an international environment.
A vantage point at the interface of the client, commissioning organization, designers, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
